title: AI-generated art for Steam Games, 2025 Reality.
author: CostaMakes
selftext:
I have been developing my Waifu Roguelike Deckbuilder, and I need a lot of Waifus cards, so I generated them with ComfyUI. 

How is it going with the release of the games with AI-generated art?

replies.author: CostaMakes
replies.body: Yes, cuz I like deckbuilders and this setting and don’t care if the graphics fit the lore.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body:
"don't care about the graphics"

You're the OP talking about graphics.

replies.author: Conscious_Guess_6032
replies.body: I think you are lying to yourself

replies.author: ConcussionCrow
replies.body: It's low effort, at least do a better job selecting the AI output / art direction. You won't find many people out there that "don't care about the graphics"

comments.author: isa_marsh
comments.body: The axe changing right in the middle of the animation is really distracting.

comments.author: superkickstart
comments.body: I doubt most people care. But many do and they are the loudest. Just create as good art as you can and don't be too lazy about it. Obvious ai art will stand out. Its kinda like bad and good cgi. You don't really notice the good one.

comments.author: CostaMakes
comments.body: Thanks for the detailed feedback! Will continue experimenting.

comments.author: ArcyRC
comments.body:
Is it an *erotic* game, then?
Those are some hot Orcs.
